issues.detail: The Greek 'ο επιστρεψας' is a participle modifying the subject (the one who returns), but the Vietnamese translation 'kẻ nào đem một người có tội trở lại' adds an extra object ('đem một người' - bringing a person) that is not in the Greek text. The Greek simply means 'the one who returns [himself] from his way of error'.
